name: ant_living_bridge
description: A living bridge of army-ant workers: a sagging chain of linked dark red-brown workers (side view) spanning a gap, one body thick at the ends and three layers deep in the middle, legs hooked across every join, the end ants gripping the twig tips. Twigs not included. Centre anchor; x -300..300, y -40..160; end grips at (-300,0) and (+300,0), lowest sag about (0,+150).
